verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֗וֹם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹנָתָ֤ן בֶּן־ שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל־ הַנַּ֙עַר֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔יו לְכָ֗ה וְנַעְבְּרָה֙ אֶל־ מַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַלָּ֑ז וּלְאָבִ֖יו לֹ֥א הִגִּֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm way·yō·mer yō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šā·’ūl ’el- han·na·‘ar nō·śê ḵê·lāw lə·ḵāh wə·na‘·bə·rāh ’el- maṣ·ṣaḇ pə·liš·tîm ’ă·šer mê·‘ê·ḇer hal·lāz ū·lə·’ā·ḇîw lō hig·gîḏ
verses.literal: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to the young man bearing his armor Come let us cross over to the Philistine outpost on the other side . . . But Jonathan did not tell his father
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu um dia que Jônatas, filho de Saul, disse ao seu escudeiro: Vem, e passemos à guarnição dos filisteus, que está do outro lado. A seu pai, porém, não disse nada.

verses.original: וְשָׁא֗וּל יוֹשֵׁב֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַגִּבְעָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת הָרִמּ֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּמִגְר֑וֹן וְהָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֔וֹ כְּשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·’ūl yō·wō·šêḇ biq·ṣêh hag·giḇ·‘āh ta·ḥaṯ hā·rim·mō·wn ’ă·šer bə·miḡ·rō·wn wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ‘im·mōw kə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Saul was staying under the pomegranate tree in Migron on the outskirts of Gibeah And the troops who were with him numbered about six hundred men
verses.literalPt: Saul estava sentado na extremidade de Gibeá, debaixo da romeira que está em Migrom, e o povo que estava com ele era cerca de seiscentos homens.

verses.original: וַאֲחִיָּ֣ה בֶן־ אֲחִט֡וּב אֲחִ֡י אִיכָב֣וֹד׀ בֶּן־ פִּינְחָ֨ס בֶּן־ עֵלִ֜י כֹּהֵ֧ן׀ יְהוָ֛ה בְּשִׁל֖וֹ נֹשֵׂ֣א אֵפ֑וֹד וְהָעָם֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י הָלַ֖ךְ יוֹנָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥî·yāh ḇen- ’ă·ḥi·ṭūḇ ’ă·ḥî ’î·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ben- pî·nə·ḥās ben- ‘ê·lî kō·hên Yah·weh bə·ši·lōw nō·śê ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ wə·hā·‘ām lō yā·ḏa‘ kî hā·laḵ yō·w·nā·ṯān
verses.literal: including Ahijah who was wearing an ephod He was the son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh But the troops did not know that Jonathan had left
verses.literalPt: Aías, filho de Aitube, irmão de Icabode, filho de Fineias, filho de Eli, sacerdote de Jeová em Siló, trazia o éfode. O povo não sabia que Jônatas tinha ido.

verses.original: וּבֵ֣ין הַֽמַּעְבְּר֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּקֵּ֤שׁ יֽוֹנָתָן֙ לַֽעֲבֹר֙ עַל־ מַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים שֵׁן־ הַסֶּ֤לַע מֵהָעֵ֙בֶר֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וְשֵׁן־ הַסֶּ֥לַע מֵהָעֵ֖בֶר מִזֶּ֑ה וְשֵׁ֤ם הָֽאֶחָד֙ בּוֹצֵ֔ץ וְשֵׁ֥ם הָאֶחָ֖ד סֶֽנֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇên ham·ma‘·bə·rō·wṯ ’ă·šer biq·qêš yō·w·nā·ṯān la·‘ă·ḇōr ‘al- maṣ·ṣaḇ pə·liš·tîm šên- has·se·la‘ mê·hā·‘ê·ḇer miz·zeh wə·šên- has·se·la‘ mê·hā·‘ê·ḇer miz·zeh wə·šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ bō·w·ṣêṣ wə·šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ sen·neh
verses.literal: Now there were cliffs . . . on both sides . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost One was named Bozez . . . and the other Seneh
verses.literalPt: Entre os desfiladeiros pelos quais Jônatas intentava passar à guarnição dos filisteus, havia um penhasco de uma e de outra banda: o nome de um era Bozez, e o nome do outro era Sené.

verses.original: הַשֵּׁ֧ן הָאֶחָ֛ד מָצ֥וּק מִצָּפ֖וֹן מ֣וּל מִכְמָ֑שׂ וְהָאֶחָ֥ד מִנֶּ֖גֶב מ֥וּל גָּֽבַע׃ס
verses.transliteration: haš·šên hā·’e·ḥāḏ mā·ṣūq miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn mūl miḵ·māś wə·hā·’e·ḥāḏ min·ne·ḡeḇ mūl gā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: One cliff stood to the north toward Michmash and the other to the south toward Geba
verses.literalPt: Um penhasco elevava-se ao norte, em frente de Micmás, e o outro, ao sul, em frente de Geba.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹנָתָ֜ן אֶל־ הַנַּ֣עַר׀ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֗יו לְכָה֙ וְנַעְבְּרָ֗ה אֶל־ מַצַּב֙ הָעֲרֵלִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אוּלַ֛י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לָ֑נוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין לַֽיהוָה֙ מַעְצ֔וֹר לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ בְּרַ֖ב א֥וֹ בִמְעָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ’el- han·na·‘ar nō·śê ḵê·lāw lə·ḵāh wə·na‘·bə·rāh ’el- maṣ·ṣaḇ hā·‘ă·rê·lîm hā·’êl·leh ’ū·lay ya·‘ă·śeh Yah·weh lā·nū kî ’ên Yah·weh ma‘·ṣō·wr lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ bə·raḇ ’ōw ḇim·‘āṭ
verses.literal: Jonathan said to the young man bearing his armor Come let us cross over to the outpost of these uncircumcised men Perhaps the LORD will work on our behalf Nothing can hinder the LORD from saving whether by many or by few
verses.literalPt: Disse Jônatas ao seu escudeiro: Vem, e passemos à guarnição destes incircuncidados. Talvez Jeová opere por nós, porque nada há que proíba a Jeová de livrar ou com muitos ou com poucos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔יו עֲשֵׂ֖ה כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ נְטֵ֣ה לָ֔ךְ הִנְנִ֥י עִמְּךָ֖ כִּלְבָבֶֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw nō·śê ḵê·lāw ‘ă·śêh kāl- ’ă·šer bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā nə·ṭêh lāḵ hin·nî ‘im·mə·ḵā kil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: His armor-bearer . . . replied Do all that is in your heart Go ahead I am with you heart and soul
verses.literalPt: Então, lhe respondeu o seu escudeiro: Faze tudo o que estiver no teu coração. Segue; eis que eu estou contigo para o que quiseres.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֹבְרִ֖ים אֶל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִגְלִ֖ינוּ אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān hin·nêh ’ă·naḥ·nū ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’el- hā·’ă·nā·šîm wə·niḡ·lî·nū ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Very well said Jonathan we will cross over toward these men and show ourselves to them
verses.literalPt: Disse Jônatas: Eis que passaremos aos homens e nos descobriremos a eles.

verses.original: אִם־ כֹּ֤ה יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ דֹּ֕מּוּ עַד־ הַגִּיעֵ֖נוּ אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְעָמַ֣דְנוּ תַחְתֵּ֔ינוּ וְלֹ֥א נַעֲלֶ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- kōh yō·mə·rū ’ê·lê·nū dōm·mū ‘aḏ- hag·gî·‘ê·nū ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·‘ā·maḏ·nū ṯaḥ·tê·nū wə·lō na·‘ă·leh ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: If . . . they say Wait until we come to you then we will stay where we are and will not go up to them
verses.literalPt: Se nos falarem assim: Parai até que venhamos a vós, pararemos em nosso lugar e não subiremos a eles.

verses.original: וְאִם־ כֹּ֨ה יֹאמְר֜וּ עֲל֤וּ עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ וְעָלִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־ נְתָנָ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָדֵ֑נוּ וְזֶה־ לָּ֖נוּ הָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- kōh yō·mə·rū ‘ă·lū ‘ā·lê·nū wə·‘ā·lî·nū kî- nə·ṯā·nām Yah·weh bə·yā·ḏê·nū wə·zeh- lā·nū hā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: But if . . . they say Come on up . . . then we will go up because this will be our sign that the LORD has delivered them into our hands
verses.literalPt: Porém, se disserem assim: Subi a nós; subiremos, pois Jeová nô-los entregou nas mãos. Isso nos servirá de sinal.

verses.original: וַיִּגָּל֣וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אֶל־ מַצַּ֖ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הִנֵּ֤ה עִבְרִים֙ יֹֽצְאִ֔ים מִן־ הַחֹרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִתְחַבְּאוּ־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gā·lū šə·nê·hem ’el- maṣ·ṣaḇ pə·liš·tîm way·yō·mə·rū p̄ə·liš·tîm hin·nêh ‘iḇ·rîm yō·ṣə·’îm min- ha·ḥō·rîm ’ă·šer hiṯ·ḥab·bə·’ū- šām
verses.literal: So the two of them showed themselves to the outpost of the Philistines who exclaimed Look the Hebrews are coming out of the holes in which they were hiding . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, se descobriram ambos eles à guarnição dos filisteus, que disseram: Eis que os hebreus estão saindo dos buracos em que se tinham escondido.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַמַּצָּבָ֜ה אֶת־ יוֹנָתָ֣ן׀ וְאֶת־ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֗יו וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ עֲל֣וּ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ וְנוֹדִ֥יעָה אֶתְכֶ֖ם דָּבָ֑ר פ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹנָתָ֜ן אֶל־ נֹשֵׂ֤א כֵלָיו֙ עֲלֵ֣ה אַחֲרַ֔י כִּֽי־ נְתָנָ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·nū ’an·šê ham·maṣ·ṣā·ḇāh ’eṯ- yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·’eṯ- nō·śê ḵê·lāw way·yō·mə·rū ‘ă·lū ’ê·lê·nū wə·nō·w·ḏî·‘āh ’eṯ·ḵem då̄·ḇå̄r p̄ way·yō·mer yō·w·nā·ṯān ’el- nō·śê ḵê·lāw ‘ă·lêh ’a·ḥă·ray kî- nə·ṯā·nām Yah·weh bə·yaḏ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So the men of the outpost called out to Jonathan and his armor-bearer . . . Come on up . . . and we will teach you a lesson Follow me Jonathan . . . told his armor-bearer . . . for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel
verses.literalPt: Os homens da guarnição disseram a Jônatas e ao seu escudeiro: Subi a nós, e mostrar-vos-emos uma coisa. Disse Jônatas ao seu escudeiro: Sobe após de mim, pois Jeová os entregou nas mãos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל יוֹנָתָ֗ן עַל־ יָדָיו֙ וְעַל־ רַגְלָ֔יו וְנֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָ֖יו אַחֲרָ֑יו וַֽיִּפְּלוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יוֹנָתָ֔ן וְנֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָ֖יו מְמוֹתֵ֥ת אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al yō·w·nā·ṯān ‘al- yā·ḏāw wə·‘al- raḡ·lāw wə·nō·śê ḵê·lāw ’a·ḥă·rāw way·yip·pə·lū lip̄·nê yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·nō·śê ḵê·lāw mə·mō·w·ṯêṯ ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: So Jonathan . . . climbed up on his hands . . . and feet with his armor-bearer . . . behind him And the Philistines fell before Jonathan and his armor-bearer . . . followed and finished them off
verses.literalPt: Trepou Jônatas, engatinhando com as mãos e pés, e o seu escudeiro, após dele. Os filisteus caíram diante de Jônatas, e o seu escudeiro matava-os atrás dele.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֞י הַמַּכָּ֣ה הָרִאשֹׁנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יוֹנָתָ֛ן וְנֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָ֖יו כְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים אִ֑ישׁ כְּבַחֲצִ֥י מַעֲנָ֖ה צֶ֥מֶד שָׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ham·mak·kāh hā·ri·šō·nāh ’ă·šer hik·kāh yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·nō·śê ḵê·lāw kə·‘eś·rîm ’îš kə·ḇa·ḥă·ṣî ma·‘ă·nāh ṣe·meḏ śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: In that first assault Jonathan and his armor-bearer . . . struck down about twenty men in about half an acre . . . of land
verses.literalPt: Esta foi a primeira desfeita em que Jônatas e seu escudeiro mataram cerca de vinte homens, dentro duma como meia jeira de terra.

verses.original: וַתְּהִי֩ חֲרָדָ֨ה בַמַּחֲנֶ֤ה בַשָּׂדֶה֙ וּבְכָל־ הָעָ֔ם הַמַּצָּב֙ וְהַמַּשְׁחִ֔ית חָרְד֖וּ גַּם־ הֵ֑מָּה וַתִּרְגַּ֣ז הָאָ֔רֶץ וַתְּהִ֖י לְחֶרְדַּ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ḥă·rā·ḏāh ḇam·ma·ḥă·neh ḇaś·śā·ḏeh ū·ḇə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ham·maṣ·ṣāḇ wə·ham·maš·ḥîṯ ḥā·rə·ḏū gam- hêm·māh wat·tir·gaz hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tə·hî lə·ḥer·daṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Then panic struck the Philistines in the camp in the field and among all the people Even those in the outposts and raiding parties trembled Indeed . . . the earth quaked and panic spread from God
verses.literalPt: Houve tremor no arraial, no campo e entre todo o povo; tremeram a guarnição e os saqueadores, e também estremeceu a terra, de sorte que houve grandíssimo pânico.

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֤וּ הַצֹּפִים֙ לְשָׁא֔וּל בְּגִבְעַ֖ת בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וְהִנֵּ֧ה הֶהָמ֛וֹן נָמ֖וֹג וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ וַהֲלֹֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū haṣ·ṣō·p̄îm lə·šā·’ūl bə·ḡiḇ·‘aṯ bin·yā·min wə·hin·nêh he·hā·mō·wn nā·mō·wḡ way·yê·leḵ wa·hă·lōm
verses.literal: Now when Saul’s watchmen at Gibeah in Benjamin looked and saw the troops melting away and scattering in every direction
verses.literalPt: Olharam as sentinelas de Saul que estavam em Gibeá de Benjamim, e eis que a multidão, derretendo-se, escorria para aqui e para ali.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֗וּל לָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ פִּקְדוּ־ נָ֣א וּרְא֔וּ מִ֖י הָלַ֣ךְ מֵעִמָּ֑נוּ וַֽיִּפְקְד֔וּ וְהִנֵּ֛ה אֵ֥ין יוֹנָתָ֖ן וְנֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl lā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’it·tōw piq·ḏū- nā ū·rə·’ū mî hā·laḵ mê·‘im·mā·nū way·yip̄·qə·ḏū wə·hin·nêh ’ên yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·nō·śê ḵê·lāw
verses.literal: Saul said to the troops who were with him Call the roll . . . and see who has left us And when they had called the roll they saw that Jonathan and his armor-bearer . . . were not there
verses.literalPt: Disse Saul ao povo que estava com ele: Indagai, agora, e vede quem é o que saiu dentre nós. Tendo-se indagado, eis que Jônatas e seu escudeiro não estavam ali.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שָׁאוּל֙ לַֽאֲחִיָּ֔ה הַגִּ֖ישָׁה אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּֽי־ הָיָ֞ה אֲר֧וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl la·’ă·ḥî·yāh hag·gî·šāh ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- hā·yāh ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bay·yō·wm ha·hū ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Saul said to Ahijah Bring the ark of God For at that time it . . . was with the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Saul a Aías: Traze para cá a arca de Deus. Pois a arca de Deus estava naquele dia com os filhos de Israel .

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י עַ֣ד דִּבֶּ֤ר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהֶהָמ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ הָל֖וֹךְ וָרָ֑ב פ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר שָׁא֛וּל אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֱסֹ֥ף יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ‘aḏ dib·ber šā·’ūl ’el- hak·kō·hên wə·he·hā·mō·wn ’ă·šer bə·ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yê·leḵ hā·lō·wḵ wå̄·rå̄ḇ p̄ way·yō·mer šā·’ūl ’el- hak·kō·hên ’ĕ·sōp̄ yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: While Saul was talking to the priest the commotion in the Philistine camp continued to . . . increase So Saul said to the priest Withdraw your hand
verses.literalPt: Enquanto Saul ainda falava ao sacerdote, o tumulto que havia no arraial dos filisteus ia-se crescendo; e Saul disse ao sacerdote: Retira a tua mão.

verses.original: וַיִּזָּעֵ֣ק שָׁא֗וּל וְכָל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה חֶ֤רֶב אִישׁ֙ בְּרֵעֵ֔הוּ מְהוּמָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·zā·‘êq šā·’ūl wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’it·tōw way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- ham·mil·ḥā·māh wə·hin·nêh hā·yə·ṯāh ḥe·reḇ ’îš bə·rê·‘ê·hū mə·hū·māh gə·ḏō·w·lāh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Then Saul and all his troops - assembled and marched to the battle and they found the Philistines in total . . . confusion with each man wielding the sword against his neighbor
verses.literalPt: Saul e todo o povo que estava com ele reuniram-se e foram à batalha; e cada um voltava reciprocamente a espada contra outro em grande confusão.

verses.original: וְהָעִבְרִ֗ים הָי֤וּ לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ כְּאֶתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָל֥וּ עִמָּ֛ם בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה סָבִ֑יב וְגַם־ הֵ֗מָּה לִֽהְיוֹת֙ עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־ שָׁא֖וּל וְיוֹנָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘iḇ·rîm hā·yū lap·pə·liš·tîm kə·’eṯ·mō·wl šil·šō·wm ’ă·šer ‘ā·lū ‘im·mām bam·ma·ḥă·neh sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḡam- hêm·māh lih·yō·wṯ ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ‘im- šā·’ūl wə·yō·w·nā·ṯān
verses.literal: And the Hebrews who had previously . . . gone up into the surrounding camps to join the Philistines now went over to . . . . . . the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan
verses.literalPt: Os hebreus que estavam dantes ao lado dos filisteus, tendo vindo dos arredores ao arraial deles, também vieram a unir-se com os israelitas que estavam com Saul e Jônatas.

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַמִּֽתְחַבְּאִ֤ים בְּהַר־ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּֽי־ נָ֖סוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַֽיַּדְבְּק֥וּ גַם־ הֵ֛מָּה אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’îš yiś·rā·’êl ham·miṯ·ḥab·bə·’îm bə·har- ’ep̄·ra·yim šā·mə·‘ū kî- nā·sū pə·liš·tîm way·yaḏ·bə·qū ḡam- hêm·māh ’a·ḥă·rê·hem bam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: When all the Israelites who had been hiding in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were fleeing they also joined the battle in close pursuit . . .
verses.literalPt: Da mesma maneira todos os homens de Israel que se haviam escondido na região montanhosa de Efraim, depois de terem ouvido que os filisteus fugiam, também eles os perseguiram de perto na batalha.

verses.original: וַיּ֧וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֛ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַ֨מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָבְרָ֖ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·ham·mil·ḥā·māh ‘ā·ḇə·rāh ’eṯ- bêṯ ’ā·wen
verses.literal: So the LORD saved Israel that day and the battle moved on beyond Beth-aven
verses.literalPt: Assim, livrou Jeová a Israel naquele dia, e a refrega passou além de Bete-Áven.

verses.original: וְאִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל נִגַּ֖שׂ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֹּאֶל֩ שָׁא֨וּל אֶת־ הָעָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר אָר֣וּר הָ֠אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יֹ֨אכַל לֶ֜חֶם עַד־ הָעֶ֗רֶב וְנִקַּמְתִּי֙ מֵאֹ֣יְבַ֔י וְלֹֽא טָעַ֥ם כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לָֽחֶם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš- yiś·rā·’êl nig·gaś bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yō·’el šā·’ūl ’eṯ- hā·‘ām lê·mōr ’ā·rūr hā·’îš ’ă·šer- yō·ḵal le·ḥem ‘aḏ- hā·‘e·reḇ wə·niq·qam·tî mê·’ō·yə·ḇay wə·lō ṭā·‘am kāl- hā·‘ām lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Now the men of Israel were in distress that day for Saul had placed the troops under an oath saying Cursed is the man who eats any food before evening before I have taken vengeance on my enemies So none . . . of the troops tasted any food
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Israel estavam angustiados naquele dia. Saul, porém, ajuramentou o povo, dizendo: Maldito o homem que comer pão até a tarde e até eu me vingar dos meus inimigos! Assim, todo o povo se absteve de comer.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּ֣אוּ בַיָּ֑עַר וַיְהִ֥י דְבַ֖שׁ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ bā·’ū ḇay·yā·‘ar way·hî ḏə·ḇaš ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: Then all the troops . . . entered the forest and there was honey on the ground . . .
verses.literalPt: Todo o povo veio a um bosque onde havia mel sobre a superfície do campo.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א הָעָם֙ אֶל־ הַיַּ֔עַר וְהִנֵּ֖ה הֵ֣לֶךְ דְּבָ֑שׁ וְאֵין־ מַשִּׂ֤יג יָדוֹ֙ אֶל־ פִּ֔יו כִּֽי־ יָרֵ֥א הָעָ֖ם אֶת־ הַשְּׁבֻעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō hā·‘ām ’el- hay·ya·‘ar wə·hin·nêh hê·leḵ də·ḇāš wə·’ên- maś·śîḡ yā·ḏōw ’el- pîw kî- yā·rê hā·‘ām ’eṯ- haš·šə·ḇu·‘āh
verses.literal: And when they entered . . . the forest and saw the flowing honey not one of them put his hand to his mouth because they feared the oath
verses.literalPt: Entrando o povo no bosque, corria o mel; mas ninguém chegou a mão à boca, pois o povo respeitava o juramento.

verses.original: וְיוֹנָתָ֣ן לֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֗ע בְּהַשְׁבִּ֣יעַ אָבִיו֮ אֶת־ הָעָם֒ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶת־ קְצֵ֤ה הַמַּטֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיִּטְבֹּ֥ל אוֹתָ֖הּ בְּיַעְרַ֣ת הַדְּבָ֑שׁ וַיָּ֤שֶׁב יָדוֹ֙ אֶל־ פִּ֔יו וַתָּרֹאנָה עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·nā·ṯān lō- šā·ma‘ bə·haš·bî·a‘ ’ā·ḇîw ’eṯ- hā·‘ām way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- qə·ṣêh ham·maṭ·ṭeh ’ă·šer bə·yā·ḏōw way·yiṭ·bōl ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·ya‘·raṯ had·də·ḇāš way·yā·šeḇ yā·ḏōw ’el- pîw wat·tå̄·rō·nå̄h ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: Jonathan, however had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath So he reached out the end of the staff in his hand dipped it into the honeycomb . . . and put his hand to his mouth and his eyes brightened
verses.literalPt: Jônatas, porém, não tinha ouvido quando seu pai ajuramentou o povo. Estendendo a ponta da vara que tinha na mão, molhou-a no favo de mel e chegou a mão à boca; e aclararam-se-lhe os olhos.

verses.original: וַיַּעַן֩ אִ֨ישׁ מֵֽהָעָ֜ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הַשְׁבֵּעַ֩ הִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ אָבִ֤יךָ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אָר֥וּר הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יֹ֥אכַל לֶ֖חֶם הַיּ֑וֹם וַיָּ֖עַף הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’îš mê·hā·‘ām way·yō·mer haš·bê·a‘ hiš·bî·a‘ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām lê·mōr ’ā·rūr hā·’îš ’ă·šer- yō·ḵal le·ḥem hay·yō·wm way·yā·‘ap̄ hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Then one of the soldiers told him Your father bound the troops . . . with a solemn oath saying Cursed is the man who eats food today That is why the people are faint
verses.literalPt: Então, disse um do povo: Teu pai ajuramentou solenemente o povo, dizendo: Maldito o homem que comer pão hoje! O povo estava cansado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יֽוֹנָתָ֔ן עָכַ֥ר אָבִ֖י אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ רְאוּ־ נָא֙ כִּֽי־ אֹ֣רוּ עֵינַ֔י כִּ֣י טָעַ֔מְתִּי מְעַ֖ט דְּבַ֥שׁ הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·nā·ṯān ‘ā·ḵar ’ā·ḇî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ rə·’ū- nā kî- ’ō·rū ‘ê·nay kî ṭā·‘am·tî mə·‘aṭ də·ḇaš haz·zeh
verses.literal: My father has brought trouble to the land Jonathan replied Just look . . . at how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey
verses.literalPt: Disse Jônatas: Meu pai trouxe desastre sobre a terra; vede como se me aclararam os olhos, porque provei um pouco deste mel.

verses.original: אַ֗ף כִּ֡י לוּא֩ אָכֹ֨ל אָכַ֤ל הַיּוֹם֙ הָעָ֔ם מִשְּׁלַ֥ל אֹיְבָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָצָ֑א כִּ֥י עַתָּ֛ה לֹֽא־ רָבְתָ֥ה מַכָּ֖ה בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ kî lū ’ā·ḵōl ’ā·ḵal hay·yō·wm hā·‘ām miš·šə·lal ’ō·yə·ḇāw ’ă·šer mā·ṣā kî ‘at·tāh lō- rā·ḇə·ṯāh mak·kāh bap·pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: How much better it would have been . . . if the troops had eaten freely . . . today from the plunder they took . . . from their enemies Would not . . . the slaughter of the Philistines have been much greater
verses.literalPt: Quanto mais se o povo, hoje, tivesse comido livremente do que encontrou do despojo dos seus inimigos? Pois, agora, não houve grande destroço entre os filisteus.

verses.original: וַיַּכּ֞וּ בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִמִּכְמָ֖שׂ אַיָּלֹ֑נָה וַיָּ֥עַף הָעָ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kū bay·yō·wm ha·hū bap·pə·liš·tîm mim·miḵ·māś ’ay·yā·lō·nāh way·yā·‘ap̄ hā·‘ām mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: That day after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Michmash to Aijalon the people were very faint
verses.literalPt: Feriram, naquele dia, os filisteus desde Micmás até Aijalom. O povo estava muito cansado

verses.original: וַיַּעַשׂ הָעָם֙ אֶל־ שָׁלָל וַיִּקְח֨וּ צֹ֧אן וּבָקָ֛ר וּבְנֵ֥י בָקָ֖ר וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ־ אָ֑רְצָה וַיֹּ֥אכַל הָעָ֖ם עַל־ הַדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ʿaś hā·‘ām ’el- šå̄·lå̄l way·yiq·ḥū ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār ū·ḇə·nê ḇā·qār way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū- ’ā·rə·ṣāh way·yō·ḵal hā·‘ām ‘al- had·dām
verses.literal: So they rushed greedily to the plunder taking sheep cattle and calves . . . They slaughtered them on the ground and ate . . . meat with the blood still in it
verses.literalPt: e, lançando-se ao despojo, tomou ovelhas, e bois, e bezerros, e, degolando-os no chão, comeu-os com sangue.

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לְשָׁאוּל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֥ה הָעָ֛ם חֹטִ֥אים לַֽיהוָ֖ה לֶאֱכֹ֣ל עַל־ הַדָּ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר בְּגַדְתֶּ֔ם גֹּֽלּוּ־ אֵלַ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם אֶ֥בֶן גְּדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gî·ḏū lə·šā·’ūl lê·mōr hin·nêh hā·‘ām ḥō·ṭim Yah·weh le·’ĕ·ḵōl ‘al- had·dām way·yō·mer bə·ḡaḏ·tem gōl·lū- ’ê·lay hay·yō·wm ’e·ḇen gə·ḏō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Then someone reported to Saul Look the troops are sinning against the LORD by eating meat with the blood still in it You have broken faith said Saul Roll a large stone over here at once
verses.literalPt: Noticiaram a Saul, dizendo: Eis que o povo está a pecar contra Jeová, comendo com sangue. Respondeu ele: Procedestes traiçoeiramente; trazei-me aqui já uma grande pedra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֣וּל פֻּ֣צוּ בָעָ֡ם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם לָהֶ֡ם הַגִּ֣ישׁוּ אֵלַי֩ אִ֨ישׁ שׁוֹר֜וֹ וְאִ֣ישׁ שְׂיֵ֗הוּ וּשְׁחַטְתֶּ֤ם בָּזֶה֙ וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ תֶחֶטְא֥וּ לַֽיהוָ֖ה לֶאֱכֹ֣ל אֶל־ הַדָּ֑ם וַיַּגִּ֨שׁוּ כָל־ הָעָ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ שׁוֹר֧וֹ בְיָד֛וֹ הַלַּ֖יְלָה וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl pu·ṣū ḇā·‘ām wa·’ă·mar·tem lā·hem hag·gî·šū ’ê·lay ’îš šō·w·rōw wə·’îš śə·yê·hū ū·šə·ḥaṭ·tem bā·zeh wa·’ă·ḵal·tem wə·lō- ṯe·ḥeṭ·’ū Yah·weh le·’ĕ·ḵōl ’el- had·dām way·yag·gi·šū ḵāl hā·‘ām ’îš šō·w·rōw ḇə·yā·ḏōw hal·lay·lāh way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū- šām
verses.literal: Then he said Go among the troops and tell them Each man must bring me his ox . . . or his sheep slaughter them in this place and then eat Do not sin against the LORD by eating meat with the blood still in it So that night everyone . . . . . . brought his ox . . . and slaughtered it there
verses.literalPt: Acrescentou Saul: Dispersai-vos por entre o povo e dizei-lhes: Trazei-me cá, cada um o seu boi e cada um a sua ovelha, e degolai-os aqui, e comei, e não pequeis contra Jeová, comendo com sangue. Todo o povo trouxe, naquela noite, pela mão, cada um o seu boi, e ali os degolou.

verses.original: וַיִּ֧בֶן שָׁא֛וּל מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהוָ֑ה אֹת֣וֹ הֵחֵ֔ל לִבְנ֥וֹת מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen šā·’ūl miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw hê·ḥêl liḇ·nō·wṯ miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Saul built an altar to the LORD it was the first time he had built an altar to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Edificou Saul um altar a Jeová; foi este o primeiro altar que lhe edificou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֡וּל נֵרְדָ֣ה אַחֲרֵי֩ פְלִשְׁתִּ֨ים׀ לַ֜יְלָה וְֽנָבֹ֥זָה בָהֶ֣ם׀ עַד־ א֣וֹר הַבֹּ֗קֶר וְלֹֽא־ נַשְׁאֵ֤ר בָּהֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כָּל־ הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עֲשֵׂ֑הס וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן נִקְרְבָ֥ה הֲלֹ֖ם אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl nê·rə·ḏāh ’a·ḥă·rê p̄ə·liš·tîm lay·lāh wə·nā·ḇō·zāh ḇā·hem ‘aḏ- ’ō·wr hab·bō·qer wə·lō- naš·’êr bā·hem ’îš way·yō·mə·rū kāl- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ʿă·śē·hs way·yō·mer hak·kō·hên niq·rə·ḇāh hă·lōm ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And Saul said Let us go down after the Philistines by night and plunder them until dawn . . . leaving no man alive Do what seems good to you the troops replied But the priest said We must consult . . . God here
verses.literalPt: Disse Saul: Desçamos, durante a noite, aos filisteus, e despojemo-los até o raiar do dia, e não deixemos deles um só homem. Responderam eles: Faze tudo o que bem te parecer. Então, disse o sacerdote: Cheguemo-nos aqui a Deus.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל שָׁאוּל֙ בֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים הַֽאֵרֵד֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הֲתִתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֥א עָנָ֖הוּ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al šā·’ūl bê·lō·hîm ha·’ê·rêḏ ’a·ḥă·rê p̄ə·liš·tîm hă·ṯit·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō ‘ā·nā·hū bay·yō·wm ha·hū
verses.literal: So Saul inquired of God Shall I go down after the Philistines Will You give them into the hand of Israel But God did not answer him that day
verses.literalPt: Saul consultou a Jeová: Descerei aos filisteus? Entregá-los-ás nas mãos de Israel? Porém Jeová não lhe respondeu naquele dia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל גֹּ֣שֽׁוּ הֲלֹ֔ם כֹּ֖ל פִּנּ֣וֹת הָעָ֑ם וּדְע֣וּ וּרְא֔וּ בַּמָּ֗ה הָֽיְתָ֛ה הַחַטָּ֥את הַזֹּ֖את הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl gō·šū hă·lōm kōl pin·nō·wṯ hā·‘ām ū·ḏə·‘ū ū·rə·’ū bam·māh hā·yə·ṯāh ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ haz·zōṯ hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Therefore Saul said Come here all you leaders of the troops and let us investigate . . . how this sin has occurred today
verses.literalPt: Disse Saul: Chegai-vos aqui, todos os principais do povo; informai-vos e vede em que se cometeu hoje este pecado.

verses.original: כִּ֣י חַי־ יְהוָ֗ה הַמּוֹשִׁ֙יעַ֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֧י אִם־ יֶשְׁנ֛וֹ בְּיוֹנָתָ֥ן בְּנִ֖י כִּ֣י מ֣וֹת יָמ֑וּת וְאֵ֥ין עֹנֵ֖הוּ מִכָּל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥay- Yah·weh ham·mō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl kî ’im- yeš·nōw bə·yō·w·nā·ṯān bə·nî kî mō·wṯ yā·mūṯ wə·’ên ‘ō·nê·hū mik·kāl hā·‘ām
verses.literal: As surely as the LORD who saves Israel lives even if it is my son . . . Jonathan he must die . . . But not one of the troops said a word
verses.literalPt: Pois pela vida de Jeová que salva a Israel, embora seja o culpado Jônatas, meu filho, certamente, se lhe tirará a vida. Porém nenhum de todo o povo lhe respondeu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַתֶּם֙ תִּֽהְיוּ֙ לְעֵ֣בֶר אֶחָ֔ד וַֽאֲנִי֙ וְיוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנִ֔י נִהְיֶ֖ה לְעֵ֣בֶר אֶחָ֑ד וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הָעָם֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עֲשֵֽׂה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl ’at·tem tih·yū lə·‘ê·ḇer ’e·ḥāḏ wa·’ă·nî wə·yō·w·nā·ṯān bə·nî nih·yeh lə·‘ê·ḇer ’e·ḥāḏ way·yō·mə·rū hā·‘ām ’el- šā·’ūl haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ‘ă·śêh
verses.literal: Then Saul said to all Israel You stand on one side and I and my son Jonathan will stand on the other side Do what seems good to you the troops . . . . . . replied
verses.literalPt: Então, disse a todo o Israel: Ficai vós de uma parte, e eu e meu filho Jônatas ficaremos da outra parte. Respondeu o povo a Saul: Faze o que bem te parecer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֗וּל אֶל־ יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָ֣בָה תָמִ֑ים וַיִּלָּכֵ֧ד יוֹנָתָ֛ן וְשָׁא֖וּל וְהָעָ֥ם יָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hā·ḇāh ṯā·mîm way·yil·lā·ḵêḏ yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·šā·’ūl wə·hā·‘ām yā·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: So Saul said to the LORD the God of Israel Why have You not answered Your servant this day? If the fault is with me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim, but if the fault is with the men of Israel, respond with Thummim And Jonathan and Saul were selected but the people were cleared of the charge
verses.literalPt: Disse Saul a Jeová, Deus de Israel: Mostra o que é justo. Foram implicados pela sorte Jônatas e Saul; o povo, porém, ficou livre.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל הַפִּ֕ילוּ בֵּינִ֕י וּבֵ֖ין יוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנִ֑י וַיִּלָּכֵ֖ד יוֹנָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl hap·pî·lū bê·nî ū·ḇên yō·w·nā·ṯān bə·nî way·yil·lā·ḵêḏ yō·w·nā·ṯān
verses.literal: Then Saul said Cast the lot between me and my son Jonathan And Jonathan was selected
verses.literalPt: Disse Saul: Deitai sortes entre mim e Jônatas, meu filho. Caiu a sorte sobre Jônatas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל־ י֣וֹנָתָ֔ן הַגִּ֥ידָה לִּ֖י מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָה וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֣וֹ יוֹנָתָ֗ן וַיֹּאמֶר֩ טָעֹ֨ם טָעַ֜מְתִּי בִּקְצֵ֨ה הַמַּטֶּ֧ה אֲשֶׁר־ בְּיָדִ֛י מְעַ֥ט דְּבַ֖שׁ הִנְנִ֥י אָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl ’el- yō·w·nā·ṯān hag·gî·ḏāh lî meh ‘ā·śî·ṯāh way·yag·geḏ- lōw yō·w·nā·ṯān way·yō·mer ṭā·‘ōm ṭā·‘am·tî biq·ṣêh ham·maṭ·ṭeh ’ă·šer- bə·yā·ḏî mə·‘aṭ də·ḇaš hin·nî ’ā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Tell me what you have done Saul commanded . . . him So Jonathan . . . told him I only tasted . . . a little honey with the end of the staff that was in my hand And now I must die
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Saul a Jônatas: Declara-me o que fizeste. Jônatas lho declarou e disse: Provei, na verdade, um pouco de mel com a ponta da vara que tinha na mão. Eis-me aqui; estou pronto a morrer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל כֹּֽה־ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֑ף כִּֽי־ מ֥וֹת תָּמ֖וּת יוֹנָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl kōh- ya·‘ă·śeh ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵōh yō·w·sip̄ kî- mō·wṯ tā·mūṯ yō·w·nā·ṯān
verses.literal: And Saul declared May God punish me and ever so severely if you, Jonathan do not surely die . . .
verses.literalPt: Saul disse: Assim me faça Deus e ainda mais, se não morreres sem falta, Jônatas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הָעָ֜ם אֶל־ שָׁא֗וּל הֲֽיוֹנָתָ֤ן׀ יָמוּת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָ֠שָׂה הַיְשׁוּעָ֨ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֮ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל֒ חָלִ֗ילָה חַי־ יְהוָה֙ אִם־ יִפֹּ֞ל מִשַּׂעֲרַ֤ת רֹאשׁוֹ֙ אַ֔רְצָה כִּֽי־ עִם־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ה הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיִּפְדּ֥וּ הָעָ֛ם אֶת־ יוֹנָתָ֖ן וְלֹא־ מֵֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·‘ām ’el- šā·’ūl hăyō·w·nā·ṯān yā·mūṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hay·šū·‘āh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh haz·zōṯ bə·yiś·rā·’êl ḥā·lî·lāh ḥay- Yah·weh ’im- yip·pōl miś·śa·‘ă·raṯ rō·šōw ’ar·ṣāh kî- ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ā·śāh hay·yō·wm haz·zeh way·yip̄·dū hā·‘ām ’eṯ- yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·lō- mêṯ
verses.literal: But the people said to Saul Must Jonathan die he who accomplished such a great deliverance for Israel Never As surely as the LORD lives not a hair of his head will fall to the ground for with God’s help he has accomplished this today . . . So the people rescued Jonathan and he did not die
verses.literalPt: Disse o povo a Saul: Porventura, morrerá Jônatas, que efetuou este grande livramento em Israel? Tal não suceda; pela vida de Jeová, não lhe há de cair no chão um só cabelo da sua cabeça, pois, ajudado de Deus, fez isso hoje. Assim o povo livrou a Jônatas, para que não morresse.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל שָׁא֔וּל מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים הָלְכ֥וּ לִמְקוֹמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al šā·’ūl mê·’a·ḥă·rê pə·liš·tîm ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm hā·lə·ḵū lim·qō·w·mām
verses.literal: Then Saul gave up his pursuit of the Philistines and the Philistines returned to their own land
verses.literalPt: Subiu Saul e deixou de perseguir aos filisteus, que foram para as suas terras.

verses.original: וְשָׁא֛וּל לָכַ֥ד הַמְּלוּכָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּלָּ֣חֶם סָבִ֣יב׀ בְּֽכָל־ אֹיְבָ֡יו בְּמוֹאָ֣ב׀ וּבִבְנֵי־ עַמּ֨וֹן וּבֶאֱד֜וֹם וּבְמַלְכֵ֤י צוֹבָה֙ וּבַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּבְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִפְנֶ֖ה יַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·’ūl lā·ḵaḏ ham·mə·lū·ḵāh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl way·yil·lā·ḥem sā·ḇîḇ bə·ḵāl ’ō·yə·ḇāw bə·mō·w·’āḇ ū·ḇiḇ·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ū·ḇe·’ĕ·ḏō·wm ū·ḇə·mal·ḵê ṣō·w·ḇāh ū·ḇap·pə·liš·tîm ū·ḇə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yip̄·neh yar·šî·a‘
verses.literal: After Saul had assumed the kingship over Israel he fought against all his enemies on every side the Moabites the Ammonites . . . the Edomites the kings of Zobah and the Philistines Wherever he turned he routed them
verses.literalPt: Tendo Saul tomado o reino sobre Israel, pelejou contra todos os seus inimigos ao redor: contra Moabe, e contra os filhos de Amom, e contra Edom, e contra os reis de Zobá, e contra os filisteus; e, para onde quer que se voltava, era vitorioso.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חַ֔יִל וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיַּצֵּ֥ל אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֥ד שֹׁסֵֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ḥa·yil way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq way·yaṣ·ṣêl ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mî·yaḏ šō·sê·hū
verses.literal: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites delivering Israel from the hands of its plunderers
verses.literalPt: Houve-se valorosamente, destroçou os amalequitas e livrou a Israel das mãos dos que o despojavam.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל יוֹנָתָ֥ן וְיִשְׁוִ֖י וּמַלְכִּי־ שׁ֑וּעַ וְשֵׁם֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתָ֔יו שֵׁ֤ם הַבְּכִירָה֙ מֵרַ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם הַקְּטַנָּ֖ה מִיכַֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū bə·nê šā·’ūl yō·w·nā·ṯān wə·yiš·wî ū·mal·kî- šū·a‘ wə·šêm šə·tê ḇə·nō·ṯāw šêm hab·bə·ḵî·rāh mê·raḇ wə·šêm haq·qə·ṭan·nāh mî·ḵal
verses.literal: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan Ishvi and Malchishua His two daughters were named Merab his firstborn . . . and Michal his younger daughter
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Saul foram Jônatas, Isvi e Malquisua, e os nomes de suas duas filhas eram estes: o da primogênita, Merabe, e o da mais moça, Mical.

verses.original: וְשֵׁם֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת שָׁא֔וּל אֲחִינֹ֖עַם בַּת־ אֲחִימָ֑עַץ וְשֵׁ֤ם שַׂר־ צְבָאוֹ֙ אֲבִינֵ֔ר בֶּן־ נֵ֖ר דּ֥וֹד שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm ’ê·šeṯ šā·’ūl ’ă·ḥî·nō·‘am baṯ- ’ă·ḥî·mā·‘aṣ wə·šêm śar- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ’ă·ḇî·nêr ben- nêr dō·wḏ šā·’ūl
verses.literal: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz The name of the commander of his army was Abner the son of Saul’s uncle Ner
verses.literalPt: A mulher de Saul chamava-se Ainoã, filha de Aimaás. O nome do general do seu exército foi Abner, filho de Ner, tio de Saul.

verses.original: וְקִ֧ישׁ אֲבִֽי־ שָׁא֛וּל וְנֵ֥ר אֲבִֽי־ אַבְנֵ֖ר בֶּן־ אֲבִיאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·qîš ’ă·ḇî- šā·’ūl wə·nêr ’ă·ḇî- ’aḇ·nêr ben- ’ă·ḇî·’êl
verses.literal: Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were sons of Abiel
verses.literalPt: Quis era pai de Saul, e Ner, pai de Abner, era filho de Abiel.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ חֲזָקָ֣ה עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וְרָאָ֨ה שָׁא֜וּל כָּל־ אִ֤ישׁ גִּבּוֹר֙ וְכָל־ בֶּן־ חַ֔יִל וַיַּאַסְפֵ֖הוּ אֵלָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ham·mil·ḥā·māh ḥă·zā·qāh ‘al- pə·liš·tîm kōl yə·mê šā·’ūl wə·rā·’āh šā·’ūl kāl- ’îš gib·bō·wr wə·ḵāl ben- ḥa·yil way·ya·’as·p̄ê·hū ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: And the war with the Philistines was fierce for all the days of Saul So whenever he noticed any . . . strong . . . or brave . . . man Saul would enlist him
verses.literalPt: Por todos os dias de Saul houve uma forte guerra contra os filisteus; e, sempre que Saul via a qualquer homem poderoso ou valente, o agregava a si.
